descriptionFull: Date-range selection component with preset shortcuts (last 7/14/30/90 days) in a centered modal over a blurred overlay, closed with ✕, Escape or the overlay (which discard the draft). Controlled via `selected` / `onSelect`

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text when no range is selected

props.name: triggerClassName
props.description: Custom className for the trigger button

fields.name: from
fields.description: Range start; `undefined` means nothing is selected and the placeholder shows

fields.name: to
fields.description: Range end; while unset the trigger shows `from` alone and Apply stays disabled

fields.name: label
fields.description: Preset button text; also used as the React key, so keep it unique
